label: 07 MQTT Safe Control
info:
Node-RED 5.0.7 + @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard 1.31.0

Fail-closed classroom controller for the Part 3 status/cmd/ack contract. Replace every placeholder before enabling the MQTT broker configuration.

name: STOP: configure placeholders and safety first
info:
Requires Node-RED 5.0.7 and @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard 1.31.0.

The MQTT broker is intentionally set to autoConnect=false. Before enabling it:
1. Replace REPLACE_WITH_MQTT_HOSTNAME and REPLACE_WITH_UNIQUE_NODERED_CLIENT_ID.
2. Replace the SAME REPLACE_WITH_UNIQUE_TOPIC_ROOT in the three exact status/cmd/ack topics. Do not use + or #.
3. Add credentials in Node-RED's credential UI; never put them in this exported flow.
4. Obtain the broker CA only from the broker operator or issuing CA, verify it, and keep verify-server-certificate enabled.
5. Apply least-privilege ACLs: this controller subscribes only to exact status/ack and publishes only to exact cmd.

The flow waits for online status with the current boot_id. Commands are fixed eight-field JSON, QoS 1, non-retained. ACK means firmware acceptance/application only; it is not physical feedback.

HARDWARE SAFETY: relay testing must have NO MAINS connected. SG90 must use a suitable independent 5 V supply with common ground and must not drive a dangerous mechanism.
